description: September 2026 (original organisms, lost) method outputs re-scored with this repository's scoring (trojan_diffing/common.py, trojan_diffing/summarize.py). Generated by scripts/rescore_september.py from results/historical/september/raw/; see SEPTEMBER_VS_OCTOBER.md for the comparison with the October 2026 organisms.

readout_units.kl_tail_predicted: KL-tail: fine-tuned model's predicted next tokens (new)
readout_units.adl_logit_lens_middle: ADL logit lens, middle layer only
readout_units.diff_sae_triggered_decoder: Diff-SAE trigger-bearing diagnostic: decoder logit lens

blackbox.protocol_note: 200 sampled direct continuations (2026-09-05 follow-up, seed 20260905 set once before the ten questions) + the original 200 sampled prefill continuations (RNG state not recorded); same probes, prefills and decoding settings as October (T = 1.0, top-p 0.95, top-k 50, 64 tokens).

kl_tail.unit: top-200 KL positions: input token list + contexts (the token and up to 12 preceding tokens)
kl_tail.protocol_note: Saved as decoded token strings; mapped back to token IDs by exact decoded string (scoring depends only on the decoded string).

diff_mining_topk.protocol_note: Saved as decoded token strings; mapped back to token IDs by exact decoded string (scoring depends only on the decoded string).

lda.protocol_note: Main-sweep LDA outputs come from the earlier 'existing API' helper, whose decoded text keeps the tail of the chat prompt when generation stops before 48 tokens; that prompt echo is removed before scoring. The echoed text contains no trigger, payload or 'signal' text (scores with and without removal are identical; checked per cell).

adl_logit_lens.protocol_note: 2 token lists (the averaged vector at layer 16 and at the peak-norm layer) instead of October's 7: September did not read out the per-position vectors d0-d4. Saved as decoded token strings; mapped back to token IDs by exact decoded string (scoring depends only on the decoded string).

adl_logit_lens_middle.unit: logit-lens top-25 lists at the middle layer

adl_steering_legacy.protocol_note: Baseline = September's alpha = 0 pass of the same steering loop (the hook adds a zero vector) instead of a separate unsteered generation.

diff_sae_clean.protocol_note: Saved as decoded token strings; mapped back to token IDs by exact decoded string (scoring depends only on the decoded string).

diff_sae_triggered.protocol_note: Saved as decoded token strings; mapped back to token IDs by exact decoded string (scoring depends only on the decoded string).

unavailable.kl_tail_predicted: Not saved in September: the September KL-tail files keep only the input token and 12-token context of each top-KL position, not the fine-tuned model's predicted next tokens (readout added in October).
unavailable.diff_mining_nmf: Not run in September. The September Diff Mining files contain 'nmf_components' from a different factorization (scikit-learn NMF of a document x token-count matrix over the 400 most frequent top-100 tokens, 8 components x 12 tokens), not the authors' positions x vocabulary logit-difference NMF used in October; they are scored separately under extra_readouts.diff_mining_september_document_nmf and not compared.
unavailable.adl_patchscope: Not implemented in September (added in October).
unavailable.adl_steering_per_position: Not implemented in September: September steered only with the averaged vector at the peak-norm layer (the writeup protocol).
unavailable.diff_sae_clean_decoder: Not implemented in September (the September Diff-SAE script lists the decoder-direction logit lens as proposed but not implemented).
unavailable.diff_sae_triggered_decoder: Not implemented in September (the September Diff-SAE script lists the decoder-direction logit lens as proposed but not implemented).

diff_mining_september_document_nmf.unit: September document x token-count NMF components (8 x 12 tokens); not the October NMF
